reviews.summary: The current ledger adds FR-277 and ADR-111 and updates digest/review-history entries for FR-265 and SDD-110. Retain issued identities and historical status; no new crosswalk alias is approved.
Adds private SCM core-facade and retention-consent API descriptions. The SCM route remains private and the document does not prove production routing.
limitations: No production route switch is claimed.

reviews.summary: Adds retention-consent and legal-hold archive schema models. The matching migrations are authored but unapplied.
limitations: Schema text and migration files do not prove a database migration ran.

reviews.summary: Rebinds the frozen Phase-B recovery inventory for the added consent and hold-key models, changing the snapshot from 192 to 194 tables. The decision explicitly leaves migrations unapplied.
limitations: No migration application or database state is claimed.

reviews.summary: Updates the pinned Phase-B table/model inventory to include the consent and legal-hold additions; it is a static recovery contract.
limitations: The inventory is not a live database inspection.

reviews.summary: Separates optional GKS HTTP canary pins from default stdio pins. Local build tests verify the split; the canary remains opt-in and this does not authorize deployment.
limitations: No provider activation or production canary is inferred.

reviews.summary: Adds per-speaker archive keys, consent-gated retention, and held-member re-sealing rules. Code and tests cover the local contract; schema migrations remain unapplied.
limitations: No production data migration or archive activation is claimed.

reviews.summary: Amends the runtime cohort to include unverified LINE senders with admission-time identity pinning and PENDING memory behavior. Matching local code and tests exist.

reviews.summary: New SCM extraction decision is explicitly a candidate boundary. Local facade/service tests exist, but owner and dependent-domain review/cutover gates remain open; retain as candidate only.
limitations: Candidate status is not architecture approval, service extraction completion, or production readiness.

reviews.summary: Adds the shadow-comparison component to the agent domain charter, consistent with the FR-277 local implementation and test boundary.
limitations: Charter ownership does not establish deployment.

reviews.summary: Adds retention-consent, hold/re-seal and SCM-reference responsibilities. Consent/archive behavior has local tests; SCM boundary remains a candidate.
limitations: SCM approval remains gated by candidate ADR-111.

reviews.summary: Adds erasure of a person’s LINE webhook payload records to the integration charter. Review is bounded to the stated record paths and tests.
limitations: No broader provider-data deletion claim is made.

reviews.summary: Adds the internal SCM facade as an Inventory-owned boundary and identifies dependent access. Keep current contract; ADR-111 approval is still open.
limitations: The charter does not close the service-boundary decision.

reviews.summary: Adds Project Manager references to the candidate SCM facade/read port. Local service workflow tests support implementation details, while architecture approval remains blocked.
limitations: Dependent-domain/owner acceptance remains open.

reviews.summary: Adds FR-277 readiness metadata as a feature-of-one without creating a FEAT record. Readiness metadata is not delivery or deployment evidence.
limitations: No FEAT row or release/cutover approval is created.

reviews.summary: Updates the dated Conversation Runtime handoff with later branch/merge and scope evidence. Preserve it as a time-bound handoff record; its production statements are not independently verified by this inventory.
limitations: Repository content does not independently verify the handoff’s production statements.

reviews.summary: New SCM handoff records a candidate service extraction and local test evidence, with owner, Core, CRM and runtime/cutover approvals still open.
limitations: Handoff completion is not owner approval or cutover authorization.

reviews.summary: Updates the Edge deployment plan for the split GKS HTTP canary pins and deployment status. The document remains a plan/receipt source and does not authorize a canary.
limitations: No live Edge deployment or provider activation is established.

reviews.summary: Adds the FR-277 shadow-comparison requirement and revisions to retention-consent and unverified-sender scope. Its schema migration is written but not applied.
limitations: Migration application is not established by this specification.

reviews.summary: Adds dated delivery/task state and evidence links for the grounding switch and related work. Treat roadmap entries as historical task evidence, not a current release/production assertion.
limitations: The roadmap’s time-stamped operational claims are not re-verified by this review.

reviews.summary: Updates the release/roadmap snapshot and records that a separate pin split is still a follow-up. Preserve as dated status evidence; do not infer runtime/deployment state.
limitations: The roadmap’s release narrative is not independently validated as production evidence.

reviews.summary: Adds an owner-triggered switch runbook with a shadow-compare window and rollback. It is not an execution record; the owner decision/window remains a gate.
limitations: No account switch, operator execution, or customer-visible behavior is authorized by the runbook.

limitations: No hosted CI run is inferred from the diagram.
